notes.title: Moving In Now Looks Better!
notes.content:
Item Browser

Now you can browser through your items with an in game online shop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/8fab2ced4af221de1347e88bc0ab60e95fd0697d.png


Reflections

Moving In now looks way better with proper reflection probes. This change affected the overall look of the game.

BEFORE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/5bfcbef042337531ab5c5d74f9608e5fe39f32d0.png

AFTER

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/eae5ffc6977a3941637ad552aa408f5baebc37b4.png


New Interactions!

A bunch of objects received new quirky interactions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/602d2490b1c5a7f19e7e47b8385a74f985d4920a.png


Material Changes

Materials are updated to be more vibrant and colorful.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/0e232caa176a08c7611c0b3e556f230fc2fab71d.png

Music Player

Now you can listen to chill lofi while decorating your house! We have a really cute music player as well!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/112d1b5ab91a6d2fa74056d5780d1038d98a1acc.png

Other Changes

+New Player Controller
+Custom Music
+Experimental Night Time Mode
+Bug fixes

notes.title: Small Quality of Life Update Before Next Fest
notes.content:
On Screen Controls!

Now there are on screen controls to help you better learn the controls :D With this game doesn't really need a tutorial level so that has been removed from the game. You can disable the on screen controls from the settings menu!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/b4ef8c0936583c734a090b96c01e845ab52ebc92.png

Also introducing Hand Painted Filter!

You can enable this on settings screen! It is off by default :D

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/ba399364bcdb23223e87d101b6ea63ebe86a5734.png
